Global (All).summary: Demonstrations in cities across China continue over the country's strict COVID-19 policies, as protests spread and intensify in various parts of the country.
Tensions between the US and China reach a new high as Washington warns Beijing against supporting Russia in the Ukraine conflict, with US-China trade relations under scrutiny.
Riots erupt in various parts of the city of Kherson as Russian forces withdraw from the area, amid ongoing clashes between Ukrainian and Russian fighters in the region.

United States.title: US Supreme Court Blocks President Biden’s Student Loan Forgiveness Plan
United States.summary: The US Supreme Court has blocked President Biden’s student loan forgiveness plan, dealing a significant blow to the administration’s efforts to address the issue of student debt in the country.

United States.title: House Jan. 6 Committee Issues Subpoenas to 6 Trump Allies
United States.summary: The House Jan. 6 committee has issued subpoenas to 6 Trump allies, including a former White House counsel, as part of an investigation into the events surrounding the 2021 U.S. Capitol riot.

United States.title: FBI Searching Mar-a-Lago After Trump Refuses to Return Classified Documents
United States.summary: The FBI has searched the Mar-a-Lago estate of former President Trump after he refused to return classified documents that were seized by the National Archives.

South Korea.title: South Korean President Criticized for Handling of NIS Scandal
South Korea.summary: South Korean President Yoon Suk-yeol faced criticism over his handling of a scandal involving the spy agency, which he is also the head of, amid concerns over national security and the rule of law.

South Korea.title: North Korea's Military Modernization a Threat to Regional Security: U.S.
South Korea.summary: The United States has expressed concern over North Korea's continued military modernization, which it sees as a threat to regional security and stability.

South Korea.title: South Korea and Japan to Resume Cooperation on North Korea Issues
South Korea.summary: South Korea and Japan have agreed to resume cooperation on issues related to North Korea, including its nuclear and missile programs, in a bid to strengthen regional security and stability.

Japan.title: Japanese PM Fumio Kishida visits India amid tensions with China
Japan.summary: Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida visited India, signaling a strategic shift in Japan's approach to regional security amid rising tensions with China.

Japan.title: South Korea and Japan strengthen ties despite China's influence
Japan.summary: South Korea and Japan agreed to strengthen their ties, boosting economic cooperation and strategic partnerships, despite China's growing influence in the region.

Japan.title: Japan's Kishida urges unity on China, North Korea threats
Japan.summary: Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida called for unity among regional countries to counter threats from China and North Korea amid rising tensions in the Indo-Pacific region.
